title.narrative: Strengthen the Supply Capacity of the Fruits and Vegetable Sector by Applying Proper Technologies Along the Value Chain

description.narrative: The aim of this programme is the assistance in the modernization and improvement of the food supply chain from basic production to food processing and the support to the consumer through reduction of post-harvest losses and market related technical assistance. This will be supportive to the Government#s vision to assist agro-based value chains that are technologically advanced and globally competitive guided by sound management practices and strong private sector participation leading to sustainable poverty reduction. The approach will include the examination of bottlenecks and opportunities identified by several sector studies conducted in previous projects and which are the basis for selecting the sector as a priority one by the Government. The identification of possible support institutions that can act as main counterparts for the sector and the strengthening of these institutions in terms of capacities and capabilities to provide the necessary support and services will be a main part of the selected approach. In respecting other activities in the selected sectors the actions will be closely coordinated with on-going sectoral activities implemented by other organizations in order to achieve synergies and avoid overlapping.
